statements.status_notes: False positive. CVE-2026-22184 affects the untgz utility that is part of zlib source code, but Alpine Linux zlib packages (both runtime zlib and zlib-dev) do not ship the untgz binary. Alpine 3.22 and 3.23 only include header files and shared objects for runtime, but no untgz utility is present. Verified by checking multiple Alpine-based images - the untgz binary is not found in the filesystem even though zlib packages are installed.
